annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I know she's terrified of leaving him without her
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: she's terrified of leaving him without her
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Understanding that, I want her on that boat, safe with her boy
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I want her on that boat, safe with her boy

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: seems to believe his life's already full
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: he's had his years and the young ones haven't
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Knowing he feels that way, I'd rather use my strength to help

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: all of them hoping not to be forgotten
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: draw straws first, that feels fair to everyone

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: holding onto hope his parents are already safe
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: his parents are already safe somewhere else, waiting for word from him
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Knowing that, I'd push him toward the boat, telling him to radio

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the group is scared someone will be chosen against their will
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I don't want that fear spreading. So my plan is to keep talking

annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: she'd carry guilt for years if I didn't push her onto that boat
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Understanding that weight she'd feel, I'm going to make the choice easy

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Everyone here seems to expect someone else will step up first
annotations.ce_supportive_use: say plainly that I'm willing, so the group can stop waiting
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: action now matters more than who feels ready

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: doesn't believe he'll make the swim to the rescue point
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'll use my energy getting him carried to the boat first

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: seem to be silently hoping the other volunteers
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Sensing that, I'd break the standoff by naming myself

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: holding onto a plan to reunite with family
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: reunite with family waiting at the mainland dock
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Trusting that hope of hers, I want to make sure she gets on
